rules.description: Python syntax errors prevented AST-based bug and resource checks from inspecting this file.
rules.recommendation: Fix the syntax error and rerun analysis.

rules.description: A mutable default argument is shared between function calls and may retain state unexpectedly.
rules.recommendation: Use None as the default and create a new list, dictionary, or set inside the function.

rules.description: A broad exception is silently ignored, which can hide failures and leave work incomplete.
rules.recommendation: Catch the expected exception types and handle or report the failure explicitly.

rules.description: A return in finally can suppress an exception or override an earlier return value.
rules.recommendation: Move the return outside the finally block and reserve finally for cleanup.

rules.description: A file is opened outside a context manager and may remain open if an error occurs.
rules.recommendation: Use `with open(...) as file:` so the file is closed on every exit path.

rules.description: This read loads all available content into memory at once, which can be costly for large inputs.
rules.recommendation: Process input incrementally or read a bounded number of bytes or lines.
